name: Mesa Boogie Mark IIC+ Preamp VST3 Plug-In

mentions.name: Mesa Boogie Mark IIC+ Preamp VST3 Plug-In
mentions.description: A VST3 audio plug-in that simulates a Mesa Boogie Mark IIC+ preamp purely from the circuit, using an iterative solver on a system of equations with the previous sample's state vector as the guess for each sample. Performance scales with input frequency; on a MacBook M3 it produces 2x oversampled output at 48000Hz using 50–70% of a single core, reducible to about 25% by relaxing the solution tolerance with minimal quality loss.
mentions.problem: The circuit-simulation approach seems unpopular for professional plug-ins because it was not viable for real time until modern CPU enhancements became available.
